answer.reason: The verses give one event of his own, his death before his father Terah in Ur, beyond the family ties the summary already shows.

clauses.english: died before his father Terah in Ur of the Chaldees
clauses.quote: Haran died before his father Terah

doubts: GEN 11:31 is marked but 'Haran' there is the city where Terah's family settled, not this man, so it was left out.
